audit.reasoning: Coding 'fixed-dominant' penultimate (rule 10 010 0010...) with non-strict exceptions matches the source exactly: default penultimate stress, a few exceptions where aspectual clitics -e/-me pull stress to the root-final syllable. The quotation is verbatim at Hinton 2000 sec. 6.2 pp. 115-116 in the copy fetched sources now; two further statements in the same paper (p. 119) repeat 'penultimate'. The source is a first-hand sketch by the language's only describer; the only fuller work (his 1991 MA thesis, 157 pp) is print-only and from the same fieldwork, and no later stress/prosody study of Tugun exists in Glottolog or on the web. Hence 'adequate' rather than 'well-sourced' (sketch-level paragraph, fuller thesis unread), no recode. sources.quote: In general stress falls on the penultimate syllable of words. ... There are a few exceptions, where often the aspectual clitics -e and -me shift the stress to the ultimate syllable of the root, e.g. mu-falik 'I will-return' but mu-falik-me 'I will-return-ASP'.
